alignments.note: Anarthrous substantival participle: the supplied *He that* joins the participle's own unit under rule 46 and the head stays on the word carrying the lexeme (rule 31).
Assimilated article token (rule 12); the ASV writes no *the* before *summer*, so it is unrepresented under rule 29.

Verbless clause: the construction-supplied copula joins the nominal predicate (rule 20) and the indefinite article belongs to the noun that licenses it (rule 15). Discontinuous around *wise* under rule 25.
Hiphil participle rendered attributively as *wise*; the ASV margin's *a son that doeth wisely* was read and set aside under rule 38.

No conjunction morpheme stands at the head of the second colon, so the coordinating *But* answers to nothing and is `added` under rule 14's closing sentences; the ASV italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
Anarthrous substantival participle with supplied *he that* under rule 46, headed on the lexeme.
Assimilated article token with no written *the* (rules 12, 29).
Copula and indefinite article join the nominal predicate as in the first colon (rules 20, 15).

Articleless attributive recast as a relative clause keeps the supplied relative with the attributive (rule 41); the light verb plus complement heads on *shame* (rule 44). The margin's *that doeth shamefully* was read and set aside (rule 38).

review_notes: The second colon has no waw, so the ASV's *But* is the one `added` unit in the verse.
Both assimilated article tokens go unrepresented; the ASV writes *in summer* and *in harvest* anarthrously.
